description: Each scoreboard.json row stores defk version, commit, the MD5 of its kernels' generated C (+ build inputs), date, machine, loads. --snapshot no longer needs --all: it merges the measured rows and keeps the others with their stamps. The generated tables show the stamp per row. Bench cache: a stamped row is reused by default; it is measured again only with --only <name> / --fresh (explicit request).
title: Stamp every measured result (version, commit, kernels' C hash) and let --snapshot update only the measured rows
